text:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up — Jordan's new hire (Casey, Sr Infra PM) starts Mon 9am PT. I put together a compact manager checklist + who-to-ask list.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Awesome, thanks. Plan to do a 30-min intro + quick team stand. Can we get laptop + AWS keys before Monday?
Alex (IT): There's an Okta device/order request slot open. Jordan, can you confirm laptop model & any extra peripherals? I also need the SSO groups Casey should be in.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Confirmed: MacBook Pro 14" with company image. Access: aws-prod-read, infra-sre, github-org, gcp-project-analytics.
Maya (People Ops): Adding to the checklist. Quick access checklist (condensed):
```
Before Day 1: create Okta account, order laptop, invite to Slack, add to payroll.
Day 1: badge pickup, SSO login, MFA setup, intro to team & buddy meet.
Day 2: dev env + repo access, first codebase walkthrough, tooling keys.
Week 1: 1:1s (manager + buddy), runbook tour, small onboarding task.
30/60/90 (manager outline): 30 - learn/context + ship a small refactor; 60 - own a service area; 90 - lead a mini project and present learnings.
```
Rae (Onboarding Buddy): I'll be Casey's buddy — will ping for a 1pm coffee on Day 1 and send the "first week map" calendar invite.
Jordan (Eng Manager): For the 30/60/90: 30 get up to speed on infra stack & configs, 60 own backlog items, 90 propose and lead a reliability improvement.
Maya (People Ops): Payroll + forms are in. Jordan, please drop a copy of the signed offer into #people-ops-private for records.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Also need demo env svc-account. @Alex can you provision a least-privilege service acct with short-lived token access for Casey?
Alex (IT): Will spin up a service account and add infra-read role. ETA: EOD tomorrow. I'll DM the credentials flow and expiration policy.
People Ops Bot: Reminder — new-hire checklist created: https://okta.example/onboard/2172347890 :calendar:
Rae (Onboarding Buddy): Team intro plan: Mon 10am round-robin intros, Mon 3pm shadow infra oncall. I'll send invites and attach a 1-pager we use for quick team context.
Maya (People Ops): Sent compact manager checklist into Jordan's DMs. Anything else we should add to the "manager passport"?
Jordan (Eng Manager): Can we get a short security briefing during week1? Ping @sec-team.
Maya (People Ops): @sec-team — can you do a 15m runthrough on secrets/credential hygiene for new hires? Prefer Mon afternoon.
Sam (Security): Got it. I'll block Mon 4pm and send a 5-min pre-read ('handling-credentials.md') + the 6 must-dos checklist.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Perfect. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
